confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from a few aggregated, partly dated sources in pesos (some from 2025 and early 2026), converted at an implied rate of roughly 1,560 ARS per USD derived from an Expatistan Ushuaia beer price. Argentine peso prices move quickly, so these are rough. Restaurant meal anchors are bounded by conflicting sources: budget meals were around USD 3-15, and sit-down three-course meals for two around USD 45-60. Cocktail and wine rest on a single Ushuaia cocktail data point and a Buenos Aires herald-era wine glass estimate, with the cocktail set at about 2.5 times the beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Ushuaia's tourist-town pricing, not from live listings, and carry the highest uncertainty. The RBA observation is dated 2026-11-18, later than the July 2026 pricing window, so it is the latest published rate rather than a rate for the window itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a Patagonian tourist gateway in Argentina, benchmarked against Buenos Aires peso-price levels (cappuccino and draft beer around ARS 6,000 in mid-2026) with a premium for Ushuaia's remote, tourism-driven prices. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a small, seasonal Patagonian tourist town, with no live booking data used.
